items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was that Mary Luke Williams apartment when she lived in Harlem.

ctx.x: Do you remember what the occasion was?
I think it was that Mary Luke Williams apartment when she lived in Harlem. It was either there or backstage at a theater. You cannot tell from the picture.
Is this the famous apartment where all those musicians got together?
